payload.rationale: This is a minimal test document — a single Tanya quote about omitted refs creating topic branches — so the extraction passes need the surrounding graph context to correctly classify it. I expanded both sample documents (the product vision and sprint retro) to give the passes the document provenance anchors, plus the core narratives (AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionsEvaporate) and key positions (AntiPatternRealtimeChat, ContextPreservationNextSprint, Sprint4ThesisProven, WebhookArchitecture) that Tanya's voice and themes could brush against. The StyleObservation for direct-quote attribution is included so the passes can recognize Tanya's quoted speech pattern. I deliberately did not expand pricing or target-market positions (PricingTwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus, TargetMarketRemoteTeams) because this test document has no pricing or market content.
